title: #theatre #nyc #offbroadway #fyp
transcript: okay this is a PSA for anyone who likes to see theatre in New York there is a very cool resource that most of us are sleeping on and they didn't ask me to post this by the way they don't even know that I'm posting this but this is a website that calls itself the most comprehensive guide to New York City theatre and as far as I can tell they have absolutely earned that title website is called StageSpotlightNYC[dot]com and funny story I actually found this website kind of a while ago and then I forgot what it was called and then couldn't find it again and it wasn't until like a year later that my friend texted it to me being like hey have you heard of this website? and I was like oh my god thank you this has been driving me crazy every day they post a list of as far as I can tell every single theatrical production playing in New York City that day except for Broadway shows, I believe I assume because there's already plenty of resources out there for that but when it comes to non-Broadway shows it's true that this is way more comprehensive than any other theatre listing I've seen in New York the website appears to be run by someone named Charlie who is absolutely doing the lord's work here and as you can see there's more info on the website about how it works what their mission is they have a newsletter they have an IG page again they did not ask me to post this I genuinely just think this should be on more people's radar
